company.name: Polymath Network
company.shortDescription: Polymath is the interface between financial securities and the blockchain.
company.description: Polymath Network (Polymath) is a decentralized protocol that makes it easier to raise capital and create security tokens. The Security Token Standard, ERC-1400, embeds regulatory requirements into the tokens themselves, restricting trading to verified participants only. The protocol simplifies the complex technical challenges of creating a security token and aims to bring the multi-trillion dollar financial securities market to the blockchain.

aiResearchSummary.text: Polymath Network is researching distributed cryptographic tokens with downstream administrative control, focusing on platforms that enable centralized control over updates to a distributed cryptocurrency network by including administrative users and separate rule sets. Additionally, they are developing methods and systems for private identity verification, which use cryptographically secure commitments to protect user identifiers. These areas reflect their work at the intersection of blockchain, security, and identity.
